method: Actual PNG viewed; actual matching baseline (when available), complete sidecar submitted prompt, batch contract and current component template checked under review-execution-contract.
selectedState: Guest clean source editor, current-note find/replace open with empty query and zero results
fieldActionRoleStateChecks: Guest document/source modes, source active, saved status, save disabled for clean draft and return-reading retained with exact manual-save/no-upload help. No owner toolbar or invented find opener.

Keyboard-opened find strip correctly has empty focused query, 0/0 matches, disabled previous/next and replace actions, unchecked case switch, editable replacement input and available close. Blank query is not an error.

Editable Markdown markers/body, no line-number gutter and 65-character metric retained. Source/resource/CAS/anonymous-CSRF, busy/read-only and IME replacement guards remain source contracts; blank body is allowed.

styleFindings.finding: Light raster texture/blue shading, approximate scale and dense icon geometry are illustrative. Use shared flat CSS tokens, source toolbar overflow and sidebar resizing; this is not an exact CSS measurement or a regeneration blocker.

Source-count label reads 源码字数 rather than source 源码字符. Same visible 65-character metric/state, no capability or guard drift; keep exact source copy in implementation without another bitmap iteration for this synonym.

limitations: Static review does not prove guards, action execution, role enforcement, keyboard/focus, resizing or responsive behavior.
Selected state only; closed menus and mutually exclusive flag/error/busy/recovery branches remain separately mapped.
Per-image result does not complete global coverage/consistency review or authorize product implementation.
rulingsApplied: Current baseline flag/state and template conditionals override generic all-state lists.
